text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I found a rose garden that's in full 
bloom. Would you like to go together, if 
you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, thank you very much!\nI'm so honored 
to be escorted by you, Flash-san♪"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I haven't been to a rose garden 
since kindergarten. I'll have to make sure 
not to touch them this time...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... Actually, back then, I got a 
thorn stuck in my hand and started 
bawling... It's a really embarrassing 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, I shall serve as your 
shield, Scarlet-san, and keep the thorns 
away. Ich werde dich beschützen.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah, u-umm, yes! Thank you so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Flash-san, you look just like a 
knight from a storybook. So cool, and so 
dashing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. You're the star 
of the day, so please feel free to rely on 
me just like a princess would.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? Well then... if you don't 
mind—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I leave it to you, my knight. ...Just 
kidding, hehehehe.
